programme.title: South Park: Chirurgie Esthétique
programme.desc: M. Garrison doit subir une rhinoplastie et se fait remplacer par la sulfureuse Mlle Ellen.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Barbara Streisand cherche à former le diamant de Panthéos pour revêtir sa forme ultime, Mecha Streisand, et détruire South Park.

programme.title: South Park: La mère de Cartman est une folle du cul
programme.desc: Cartman ignore qui est son père. Alphonse Mephisto veut bien l'aider mais les recherches coûtent 3000 $.
programme.sub-title: La mère de Cartman est une folle du cul

programme.title: South Park: La mère de Cartman est toujours une folle du cul
programme.desc: Le suspense est à son comble, Mephisto va dévoiler qui est le père de Cartman, lorsque soudain on lui tire dessus.
programme.sub-title: La mère de Cartman est toujours une folle du cul

programme.title: South Park: Le Charmeur de poules
programme.desc: Le bibliobus arrive à South Park. Les enfants n'en ont cure, jusqu'à ce qu'une affaire de viol de poules n'éclate.

programme.title: South Park: Le Zizi de Ike
programme.desc: Kyle apprend que ses parents veulent faire circoncire son frère. Pendant ce temps, M. Mackey découvre la drogue.

programme.title: South Park: Le Foetus Siamo Maxiliaire
programme.desc: Les citoyens de South Park viennent en aide à l'infirmière de l'école, qui a une étrange dégénérescence médicale.

programme.title: South Park: La grenouille mexicaine hypnotique du sud du Sri Lanka
programme.desc: Jimbo et Ned animent une émission sur la chasse sur une chaîne du câble.
programme.sub-title: La grenouille mexicaine hypnotique du sud du Sri Lanka

programme.title: South Park: La Ville au bord de l'Eternité
programme.desc: Le bus scolaire est coincé face à une falaise. Mlle Crabtree va chercher de l'aide et devient alors une vedette.
programme.sub-title: La Ville au bord de l'Eternité

programme.title: South Park: L'Eté, Ca Craint
programme.desc: Alors que Jimbo et Ned veulent faire des feux d'artifice pour le 4 juillet, M. Garrison s'aperçoit que M. Toc a disparu et qu'il est 'son côté gay'.

programme.title: South Park: Les Boulettes du Chef au Chocolat Salé
programme.desc: Le festival de Sundance arrive à South Park. Mais les festivaliers étouffent M. Hankey avec leurs déjections pleines de nourriture bio.
programme.sub-title: Les Boulettes du Chef au Chocolat Salé

programme.title: South Park: La Varicelle
programme.desc: Les parents de South Park décident de donner la varicelle à leurs enfants pour éviter qu'ils ne l'attrapent vieux.

programme.title: South Park: Roger Ebert Devrait Manger moins de Gras
programme.desc: La classe de Mr. Garrison est emmenée au planétarium de South Park, qui est un lieu des plus ennuyeux.
programme.sub-title: Roger Ebert Devrait Manger moins de Gras

programme.title: South Park: La Garçonnière
programme.desc: Alors que Stan doit construire une garçonnière pour jouer à 'action ou vérité' avec Wendy, ses parents se séparent.

programme.title: South Park: Les Journées Vaches
programme.desc: C'est la fête de la vache à South Park. La programmation inclut rodéo et fête foraine.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Aid
programme.desc: Chef a été spolié: on lui a volé des droits sur ses chansons.

programme.title: South Park: Poisson Sanglant
programme.desc: Tante Flo, la sœur de Sharon Marsh, offre à son neveu un poisson rouge. Mais Stan découvre que c'est en réalité un serial killer.

programme.title: South Park: Joyeux Noël Charlie Manson
programme.desc: Kyle, Kenny et Cartman s'en vont pour les fêtes de Noël dans le Nebraska pour aller rendre visite à la grand-mère de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park: Gnomes
programme.desc: Mr. Tweek risque de perdre son café à cause de la concurrence des cafés Harbucks.

programme.title: South Park: Tropicale, Schtropicale
programme.desc: Les garçons sont envoyés dans la forêt tropicale du Costa Rica avec les enfants de la chorale.

programme.title: South Park: Combustion Spontanée
programme.desc: Les citoyens de South Park prennent feu sans explication. Trouvera-t-on la cause de ces combustions spontanées?

programme.title: South Park: La Maman de Chef
programme.desc: Depuis que Chef a rencontré la fille de ses rêves, les garçons se sentent delaissés.

programme.title: South Park: Tweek contre Craig
programme.desc: Les garçons forcent leurs réticents camarades de classe, Tweek et Craig à se battre.

programme.title: South Park: Les Jakovasaures
programme.desc: Cartman découvre un Jakovasaure femelle, puis un mâle.

programme.title: South Park: Le Panda du Harcèlement Sexuel
programme.desc: Un panda, venu dans la classe de Stan et de ses amis expliquer le principe du harcèlement sexuel et encourager sa dénonciation, déclenche une folie du procès à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Orgie de Chat
programme.desc: Mme Cartman va à la fête donnée chez M. Mackey et laisse son fils sous la garde de Shelly Marsh.

programme.title: South Park: Deux Hommes tout Nus dans un Jacuzzi
programme.desc: Après avoir laissé Shelley chez les Cartman, la famille Marsh se rend chez M. Mackey, et Stan est relégué à la cave avec d'autres enfants pas très fréquentables. Pendant ce temps, les papas de South Park expérimentent le jacuzzi.
programme.sub-title: Deux Hommes tout Nus dans un Jacuzzi

programme.title: South Park: Les Scouts juifs
programme.desc: Pendant que leurs parents sont à la fêtes, Kyle, Ike et Kenny sont à une fête religieuse juif. Ils se rendent compte rapidement que cette cérémonie sera propice à un complot.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpokomon
programme.desc: Les enfants sont pris dans la folie Chinpokomon qui est en fait une conspiration anti-americaine de nostalgiques de Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: South Park: Ethernopien dans l'Espace
programme.desc: Pascal la Dalle cherche où reloger son village pour qu'ils échappent aux missionnaires chrétiens.

programme.title: South Park: Korn et le Mystère Mystérieux
programme.desc: À l'approche d'Halloween, South Park est en effervescence, sauf le père Maxi qui considère cette fête comme une vénération de Satan.

programme.title: South Park: Les Comptines du Singe Batteur
programme.desc: Un concours d'orthographe a lieu à South Park. Deux enfants qui sont scolarisés à domicile remportent le trophée alors que Cartman avait une arme secrète : les comptines du singe batteur.

programme.title: South Park: Médaille de Connerie avec Palme
programme.desc: Une reconstitution de la bataille de la guerre de Sécession, opposant les Nordistes aux Sudistes, est organisée à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Les Chants de Noël de M.Hankey
programme.desc: Mr Hankey nous présente ses meilleurs vœux sous forme de showcase musical où tout le monde participe.
programme.sub-title: Les Chants de Noël de M.Hankey

programme.title: South Park: Dieu es-tu là ? C'est Jésus à l'appareil
programme.desc: Le monde se prépare à passer à l'an 2000, à South Park, on s'attend à ce que Jésus fasse venir Dieu sur Terre pour le millénium.
programme.sub-title: Dieu es-tu là ? C'est Jésus à l'appareil

programme.title: South Park: Le Bruit Marron
programme.desc: Un énorme concert de flûtes à bec dirigé par Yoko Ono et réunissant les enfants de tous les États-Unis doit se dérouler dans l'Arkansas.

programme.title: South Park: Inqualifiable crime de haine
programme.desc: Les filles défient les garçons à la luge. Les garçons acceptent, certains de gagner grâce au cul de Cartman.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The assassins of Baroque Works gather at Spider’s Café, and the Straw Hats arrive at Yuba only to find it buried in sand.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Crocodile reveals himself to the Baroque Works assassins and discloses his dastardly plan for Alabasta. After departing Yuba, Luffy takes a stand that forces Vivi to rethink her mission.
programme.sub-title: Luffy vs. Vivi! The Tearful Vow to Put Friends on the Line

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Vivi takes Luffy’s advice, and the Straw Hats head towards Rainbase for a confrontation with Crocodile. Karoo finally reaches the palace with Vivi’s warning for King Cobra.
programme.sub-title: The Battlefront of Alabasta! Rainbase, the City of Dreams

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy leads a daring – but foolish – raid on Crocodile’s casino. His poor planning lands him behind bars with Captain Smoker – and more importantly, leaves Vivi unprotected.
programme.sub-title: The Trap of Certain Defeat! Storming Raindinners!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While the Straw Hats are stuck in the clink, King Cobra addresses the starving people of Nanohana. Will his unbelievable revelation drive his subjects past the brink of rebellion?
programme.sub-title: Operation Utopia Commences! The Swell of Rebellion Stirs!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A royal imposter has the rebel army hell-bent on bringing Cobra’s reign to a violent end. Meanwhile, Luffy and his mates find themselves in deep trouble and even deeper water.
programme.sub-title: The Terrifying Banana Gators and Mr. Prince!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji shows up in the nick of time to make the crocs cough up the key to Luffy’s freedom, but the ravenous reptiles spit up something else instead.
programme.sub-title: The Key to a Great Comeback Escape! The Wax-Wax Ball!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Crocodile snatches Vivi off the back of a giant crab, but Luffy’s not having it. The rubber-man goes toe-to-toe with the sandman in a battle that will end in bloodshed.
programme.sub-title: Merciless Mortal Combat! Luffy vs Crocodile

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Crocodile puts Luffy down for a never-ending dirt nap, and the Straw Hats get a lift from a crabby ally in their race to stop the looming rebellion.
programme.sub-title: Dash For a Miracle! Alabasta Animal Land

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Vivi arrives in Alubarna with just enough time to stop the rebellion, but the agents of Baroque Works lurk in every corner, waiting to sabotage her plans for peace.
programme.sub-title: Rebel Army vs. Royal Army! Showdown at Alubarna

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji buys Vivi some time by mixing it up with a foe of many faces. Outside Alubarna’s walls, Chopper and Usopp tangle with Miss Merry Christmas and her slugging sidekick.
programme.sub-title: Alubarna Grieves! The Fierce Captain Karoo

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Usopp finally shows some courage by using a five-ton hammer to play whack-a-mole with Miss Merry Christmas. He may be bluffing, but the distraction lets Chopper zero in on the enemy’s weakness.
programme.sub-title: Sworn on a Friend's Dream! The Battle of Molehill, Block 4

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Chopper’s Rumble Ball could be the difference between life and death in the mole ballgame. Elsewhere, Sanji has trouble kicking a pretty enemy, and Vivi proposes something unthinkable.
programme.sub-title: Big Opening Day Today! The Copy-Copy Montage

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Vivi continues preparations to blow up the palace; Zorro puts his steel to the test against a lethal blade-man; Sanji tries to overcome his inability to kick a foxy lady!
programme.sub-title: Transformed into Nami! Bon Clay's Rapid-Fire Ballet Kenpo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Things don’t look good for the prettiest Straw Hat. Nami’s about to tangle with a thorny adversary, and the weapon Usopp built her is only good for party tricks!
programme.sub-title: Nami's Cyclone Advisory! Clima Tact Burst!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Crocodile reveals his sinister motives for attacking Alabasta, and Nami tries to end her duel with Miss Doublefinger by unleashing the Clima Tact’s ultimate weapon: a devastatingly lethal tornado!
programme.sub-title: Secret Passed Down In The Royal Family! The Ancient Weapon Pluton!

programme.title: One Piece

programme.sub-title: Where Vivi's Voice Gets Heard! The Hero Descends!

programme.desc: Luffy finally discovers the secret to knocking out a sandman, but it won’t matter unless Vivi and the rest of the Straw Hats can locate the Baroque Works bomber.

programme.desc: While his mates search for a bomb, Luffy narrowly survives his second scrape with Crocodile. Across town, Nico Robin strong-arms Cobra into revealing his country’s greatest secret.

programme.desc: The Odd Squad/For Emergencies Only: Timmy wishes he had a talking car. Cosmo and Wanda are so busy with Poof they’re neglecting Timmy.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Cheese and Crockers/Land Before Timmy: Timmy wishes up a machine that allows him to merge with other items to become half-Timmy/half-whatever. Timmy’s tired of technology taking over and ruining his life so he wishes for a simpler world.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Merry Wishmas!: When Timmy doesn’t get what he wants for Christmas he simply wishes for it. But his friends can’t do the same, so Timmy wishes every kid could get a magical coupon that would allow them to wish for the one thing they didn't get.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: King Chang/The End of the Universe-ity: Shya! Mark Chang is called back to Yugopotamia to become king while his father, under attack from a mystery assailant, flees for his life. Dark Laser’s back and tries to make Timmy his apprentice!
programme.sub-title: King Chang/The End of the Universe-ity

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Sooper Poof: Poof is trying to get the hang of shape shifting – unfortunately he takes after Cosmo! Timmy’s been running Cosmo and Wanda ragged so Jorgen takes him to "Wishing Well."

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Wishy Washy/Poof's Play Date: Dad entrusts Timmy with washing and preserving his classic Stryker Z sports car! Wanda worries that Poof doesn’t have interaction with other fairy babies, so Timmy turns the adult fairies into babies, so Poof can play with.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Vicky Gets Fired/CHINdred Spirits: Vicky is determined to get a job after Timmy's parents fire her. Timmy wishes up a girlfriend for Crimson Chin and soon the Chin dating a woman named Golden Locks…except now the comic is both boring and romantic.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: 9 Lives/Dread 'n' Breakfast: When Catman tells Timmy that he’s used up 8 of his 9 cat lives saving Dimmsdale from crime, Timmy helps Catman find a "safer" job where he can still help people. Mom turns the house into a bed and breakfast!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Birthday bashed/Momnipresent: Timmy is excited for his birthday until he realizes that one year older means one year closer to losing his fairies. He spends the entire day trying to thwart all party plans, leading his Mom and Dad to think he's gone crazy!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Timmy goes on an adventure to search for his fairies and a magical wand that will defeat the Darkness.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Timmy goes on an adventure to search for his fairies and a magical wand that will defeat the Darkness.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Timmy learns he merely slowed down The Darkness and now he must seek a second wand to defeat this evil force. Timmy is forced to make amends with his enemies in order to fight for mankind.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Confident and secure, Timmy feels great having won the battle against The Darkness. His world is quickly turned upside down as he learns that he didn’t win, but is now living inside The Darkness!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Anti-Poof: For every fairy, there’s an anti-fairy – thus anti-Poof is born – FOOP! It’s up to Poof to stop this anti-fairy from destroying Fairy World and his loved ones.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Add-A-Dad/Squirrely Puffs: Dad is too busy to spend quality time with Timmy, so he wishes up "a-lot-a-dads" to hang out with. It's a race between the Squirrely Scouts and the Cream Puffs to the top of Mount Doom!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Mice-Capades/Formula For Disaster: Poof has been watching too much of a classic, yet violent "cat & mouse" cartoon. He innocently turns Timmy and Vicky into "Cheesy and Sleazy" and all mayhem breaks loose.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Bad Heir Day/Freaks and Greeks: Crocker wants an heir to his supposed "fortune and fame." Poof coincidentally ends up in his care and Crocker is set for life.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Fly Boy/Temporary Fairy: Everybody in Dimmsdale is watching the latest horror film, "Fly Boy." But Timmy isn't allowed to, so when he wishes to become a "fly on the wall".

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Crocker Shocker/Super Zero: Crocker is hypnotized into no longer believing in fairies and becomes normal again. Unfortunately, Fairy World can no longer feed off his spastic energy, and all their magic shuts down.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Dadbracadbra/Timmy Turnip: With a little help from Timmy, Dad’s magic tricks really work. Convinced that Timmy’s dad is a fairy, Crocker is out to prove it and uncover his secret on national television.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: One Man Banned/Frenemy Mine: After Timmy’s rejected from the school band, he wishes everyone would love his music./Timmy saves Vicky from a horrible accident and suddenly she is stricken by his generosity.

programme.sub-title: The Boss of Me/He Poofs, He Scores!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: When Timmy gripes that being Mom is easier than being a kid, Wanda takes the bait and switches their brains. Now Mom is Timmy, and Timmy is Mom!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: When Mom and Dad mistake Cosmo for a ghost and restart their failed ghost-hunting business, Timmy wishes that the fairies would pretend to haunt Dimmsdale.

programme.desc: Do couples give up too easily on marriage? More newlyweds, married only a few months, are pulling off their wedding bands and calling it quits. Dr. Phil's guests haven't even been married a year, and are already wondering if they made the right decision.

programme.sub-title: Ex-Wife, New Wife, And Daughter Caught In The Middle Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: "Van Life" to Vanished: Inside Gabby Petito's Disappearance And Death Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: I Believe My Ex Murdered Our Children Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Can a man introduce another woman into his marriage and form a healthy, "triangular" relationship, in which he is shared by his wife and his mistress? Part 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dana says daughter Melanie, 23, is a drug abuser whose behavior is ripping apart their peaceful family. Melanie admits to experimenting with drugs but says she's not addicted & she blames her mom for pushing her buttons and causing her to lose her cool.
programme.sub-title: A Daughter On The Brink: Did Mom Push Her Over The Edge?

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: My Daughter Went From Being A School Counselor With A Master's Degree To Losing Her Children & Living In An RV

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: Did Step-Dad Molest His Step-Daughter And Granddaughter? The Polygraph Results Pt. 2

programme.sub-title: My Wife Or My Girlfriend, Dr. Phil, You Decide

programme.sub-title: My Husband's Big Lottery Win Is Ruining Our Marriage

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: Time Is Running Out For Prison-Bound Dad: Did His Wife Blackmail Him Into Embezzling $300,000

programme.sub-title: Dr. Phil's Big Ultimatum: Will Accused Mother Heather Go To Rehab? Pt. 2
